title: How One Fast Shows a Godly Man What Owns Him
caption:
You can tell what owns a man by what he can't go a day without.

Pick the thing your hand reaches for without thinking. Fast it for one day. Pray in the hole it leaves. Write down what came up and tell a brother.

What would you reach for first?

#faith #godlymen #christianman #fasting #selfcontrol #discipline
theme: He runs his life — his impulses don't control him.
